description: Diagnostic module to identify the root cause of import chain failures in registry_api.py, rug_pull_monitor.py, and signal_analyser.py. These are protected files but are failing smoke with similar tracebacks pointing to import errors in line 10. The diagnostic MUST: (1) NOT modify any protected file; (2) Import each target module and capture the specific ImportError or ModuleNotFoundError; (3) Report which dependency is missing or conflicting; (4) NOT attempt to install or fix anything — pure diagnostic only. Outputs findings to a JSON blob written via write_service for operator review.
